svg.aria-label: Tokenizer press: the n8n Postgres comma-split bug as a bench machine. A bare slug Doe, John is guillotined at its comma into two tokens; a sleeved slug rides through whole. The counter reads 3 tokens against 2 slots, so the orange reject flag pops.
svg.text: Bare metal splits at its comma — the sleeved slug rides through whole.
3 tokens · 2 slots · REJECT — sleeved lane 2/2 OK
